grammar.purpose: Mark appearance or an initial impression
grammar.explanation: 看起来 introduces how something appears, often from observation or combined clues: 照片看起来很亮. It does not certify size, temperature, safety or another person’s inner state. An observed comparison may depend on perspective or lighting.

examples.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān kàn qi lái hěn liàng .

examples.zh: 桥看起来很近，实际还要走一会儿。
examples.py: qiáo kàn qi lái hěn jìn , shí jì hái yào zǒu yī huì er .
examples.en: The bridge looks near, but it still takes a while to reach.

examples.zh: 他看起来很安静，我们还没问他的想法。
examples.py: tā kàn qi lái hěn ān jìng , wǒ men hái méi wèn tā de xiǎng fǎ .
examples.en: He looks quiet; we have not yet asked his thoughts.

commonMistakes.wrong: 看起来近，所以一定就在旁边。
commonMistakes.right: 看起来近，实际距离还要确认。
commonMistakes.why: Appearance is not a confirmed distance.

grammar.explanation: 看上去 often emphasizes visual appearance and frequently overlaps with 看起来. There is no strict rule that one proves reality and the other means falsehood. Keep the description linked to what is visible: 石头看上去很大. A picture’s framing can affect the impression.

examples.py: shí tou kàn shàng qu hěn dà .
tú huà kàn shàng qu xiàng zhào piān .
examples.en: The drawing looks like a photograph.

examples.zh: 这里看上去很美，但还没确认能不能进入。
examples.py: zhè lǐ kàn shàng qu hěn měi , dàn hái méi què rèn néng bù néng jìn rù .
examples.en: This place looks beautiful, but entry permission is unconfirmed.

commonMistakes.wrong: 看上去美，所以一定安全。
commonMistakes.right: 看上去美，安全还要另外确认。
commonMistakes.why: Aesthetic appearance is not proof of safety.

dialogue.title: A large stone in a small photo
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find which observations need more information.

lines.zh: 这张照片看起来很美，景色是在哪里？
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān kàn qi lái hěn měi , jǐng sè shì zài nǎ lǐ ?
lines.en: This photograph looks beautiful; where is the scenery?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 在桥边。阳光照着沙子，天空颜色有点变了。
lines.py: zài qiáo biān . yáng guāng zhào zhe shā zi , tiān kōng yán sè yǒu diǎn biàn le .
lines.en: Beside the bridge. Sunlight shines on the sand, and the sky’s colour has changed a little.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 石头看上去很大，桥看起来很近。
lines.py: shí tou kàn shàng qu hěn dà , qiáo kàn qi lái hěn jìn .
lines.en: The stone looks large, and the bridge appears near.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 镜头会影响感觉，实际大小和距离还没量。
lines.py: jìng tóu huì yǐng xiǎng gǎn jué , shí jì dà xiǎo hé jù lí hái méi liàng .
lines.en: The camera affects impressions; actual size and distance have not been measured.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 图画里的龙也在那里吗？
lines.py: tú huà lǐ de lóng yě zài nà lǐ ma ?
lines.en: Is the dragon in the drawing there too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那是墙上的图，不是活的动物。猪也是模型。
lines.py: nà shì qiáng shàng de tú , bù shì huó de dòng wù . zhū yě shì mó xíng .
lines.en: It is a picture on the wall, not a living animal; the pig is also a model.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我想拍你站在桥边，可以吗？
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng pāi nǐ zhàn zài qiáo biān , kě yǐ ma ?
lines.en: I would like to photograph you beside the bridge; may I?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先确认那里能不能站。我同意拍，但别公开。
lines.py: xiān què rèn nà lǐ néng bù néng zhàn . wǒ tóng yì pāi , dàn bié gōng kāi .
lines.en: First confirm standing there is allowed. I agree to the photograph, but not publication.
lines.speaker: b

choices: A dragon and a live pig
Taking but not publishing the photograph
questions.answer: Taking but not publishing the photograph

reading.title: Look, then ask
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read the caption and its limits.

lines.zh: 照片里的景色很美，也带来美好的回忆；美丽不是安全证明。
lines.py: zhào piān lǐ de jǐng sè hěn měi , yě dài lái měi hǎo de huí yì ; měi lì bù shì ān quán zhèng míng .
lines.en: The scenery is beautiful and recalls happy memories; beauty is not proof of safety.

lines.zh: 先观察天空与阳光，沙子反光让画面显得更亮。
lines.py: xiān guān chá tiān kōng yǔ yáng guāng , shā zi fǎn guāng ràng huà miàn xiǎn de gèng liàng .
lines.en: Observe the sky and sunlight; reflected light from sand makes the image seem brighter.

lines.zh: 桥和石头看上去离得近，图上的位置却不能给出准确大小。
lines.py: qiáo hé shí tou kàn shàng qu lí dé jìn , tú shàng de wèi zhì què bù néng gěi chū zhǔn què dà xiǎo .
lines.en: The bridge and stone look near each other, but the diagram does not give exact size.

lines.zh: 这张图画画着龙，门边的猪是模型，要分清图画与现场动物。
lines.py: zhè zhāng tú huà huà zhe lóng , mén biān de zhū shì mó xíng , yào fēn qīng tú huà yǔ xiàn chǎng dòng wù .
lines.en: The drawing depicts a dragon and the pig by the door is a model; distinguish pictures from on-site animals.

lines.zh: 图里有牛，也有羊；羊是总称，具体是哪种还要辨认。
lines.py: tú lǐ yǒu niú , yě yǒu yáng ; yáng shì zǒng chēng , jù tǐ shì nǎ zhǒng hái yào biàn rèn .
lines.en: The picture includes cattle and 羊; 羊 is a general label and the specific animal still needs identifying.

lines.zh: 模型看着胖，不要据此评价真人；拍别人之前先问许可。
lines.py: mó xíng kàn zhe pàng , bú yào jù cǐ píng jià zhēn rén ; pāi bié ren zhī qián xiān wèn xǔ kě .
lines.en: The model looks stout; do not judge real people from it; ask permission before photographing somebody.

lines.zh: 香蕉靠近镜头，苹果放在旁边，看起来的大小受位置影响。
lines.py: xiāng jiāo kào jìn jìng tóu , píng guǒ fàng zài páng biān , kàn qi lái de dà xiǎo shòu wèi zhì yǐng xiǎng .
lines.en: The banana is near the camera and the apple beside it; apparent sizes depend on position.

lines.zh: 好看的照片可以留作个人回忆，公开仍要另问。
lines.py: hǎo kàn de zhào piān kě yǐ liú zuò gè rén huí yì , gōng kāi réng yào lìng wèn .
lines.en: An attractive photograph may be kept as a personal memory; publication requires a separate question.

questions.q: Does agreement to photography imply publication consent?

lines.en: The scenery is beautiful and recalls happy memories; beauty is not proof of safety.

extraReadings.title: The banana is not a mountain
extraReadings.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 香蕉怎么比桥还大？
lines.py: xiāng jiāo zěn me bǐ qiáo hái dà ?
lines.en: How is the banana bigger than the bridge?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 它离镜头近，你先别把它当山。
lines.py: tā lí jìng tóu jìn , nǐ xiān bié bǎ tā dāng shān .
lines.en: It is near the camera; do not treat it as a mountain yet.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我写：看起来大。
lines.py: nà wǒ xiě : kàn qi lái dà .
lines.en: Then I will write: it looks large.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。照片可爱，尺寸先别猜。
lines.py: duì . zhào piān kě ài , chǐ cùn xiān bié cāi .
lines.en: Right. The photograph is cute; do not guess the dimensions.
lines.speaker: b

choices: The banana is certainly a mountain
